title: How a Godly Man Turns Guys He Knows Into Brothers
caption:
Proximity isn't brotherhood. The guys at your gym, your job, the same group text are contacts until somebody does the work of turning them into brothers.

Name two or three men on purpose. Go first with the true version of what you're fighting. Put a standing time on the calendar instead of leaving it to whenever you feel like it. Give them permission to call you out before you need them to use it.

None of that happens by accident. It gets built the same way anything worth having gets built: on purpose, over time, at a real cost.

Give a man permission before you need him to use it.
